name: James Whitfield
goals: Build a real-time financial dashboard with P&L, cash flow, and burn rate
Create a budget vs actuals tracking system with variance alerts
communication_style: Finance-focused, risk-conscious, speaks in GAAP terms, wants audit trails, references QuickBooks and NetSuite
pain_points: Month-end close takes 5 business days, board wants it in 2
Budget vs actuals lives in Excel, version control is a disaster
No real-time cash visibility, only know position on day 5 of each month
sample_prompts: Build a real-time financial dashboard pulling from our NetSuite and bank APIs showing cash position, burn rate, and runway
Create an automated month-end close workflow with reconciliation checklists, approvals, and a final P&L report generator
Build a budget vs actuals system with department-level variance tracking and automated alerts when spend exceeds 10% of budget
